# Bitcoin Commons

> Open, mathematically specified Bitcoin consensus rules: the Orange Paper consensus IR and the Consensus Spec. BLVM is one implementation. Governance is forkable. The designer is not a live merge gate.

Bitcoin Commons publishes the **normative consensus specification** (Orange Paper) separately from **BLVM**, one implementation (Rust crates, node, SDK). The Orange Paper is implementation-agnostic mathematical notation; **blvm-consensus** implements and validates against it using tests and BLVM Specification Lock (Z3) on annotated functions.

For operators: download verified **`blvm`** binaries from the install page. For developers and researchers: use the documentation book for APIs, configuration, and verification methodology. Governance rules are forkable. See system status.

## Normative specification

- [Orange Paper](https://thebitcoincommons.org/orange-paper.html): Mathematical Bitcoin consensus specification, for any implementation
- [Consensus Spec register](https://thebitcoincommons.org/spec.html): Numbered rule register with cross-links and visualizations
- [Consensus math](https://thebitcoincommons.org/protocol.html): Formal consensus math (Orange Paper extended spec)
- [Implementation design](https://thebitcoincommons.org/architecture.html): Implementation algorithms and design choices: one valid approach among others

## Implementation and downloads

- [Install BLVM](https://btcdecoded.org/install): Current release binaries, checksums, and platform matrix
- [BTCDecoded llms.txt](https://btcdecoded.org/llms.txt): Machine-readable index for the install/marketing site
- [blvm (umbrella binary)](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm): BLVM node CLI and release artifacts
- [blvm-consensus](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm-consensus): Consensus rules implementation
- [blvm-spec-lock](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm-spec-lock): Specification Lock tooling. Z3 checks annotated functions. A passing check is not a body proof.

## Documentation book

- [BLVM documentation (full book)](https://docs.btcdecoded.org/blvm/introduction.html): Operators, developers, consensus, node, SDK, governance
- [Formal verification](https://docs.btcdecoded.org/blvm/consensus/formal-verification.html): Spec-lock methodology, CI gates, coverage
- [Deployment posture](https://docs.btcdecoded.org/blvm/security/deployment-posture.html): Security before exposing RPC on mainnet
- [Docs index](https://docs.btcdecoded.org/llms.txt): BTCDecoded documentation host

## Governance

- [Governance repository](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/governance): Policy YAML, tiers, and procedures
- [Whitepaper](https://thebitcoincommons.org/whitepaper.html): Bitcoin Commons project narrative and economic model
- [System status](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/.github/blob/main/SYSTEM_STATUS.md): Activation state and project phase

## Optional

- [Homepage](https://thebitcoincommons.org/): Marketing, learning paths, FAQ
- [Sitemap](https://thebitcoincommons.org/sitemap.xml): HTML page index for crawlers
- [robots.txt](https://thebitcoincommons.org/robots.txt): Crawler policy (not access control)
- [Security contact](mailto:security@thebitcoincommons.org): Vulnerability reports
